component.name: Let's Go Recomp
component.summary: Native port of Pokémon: Let's Go, Eevee! and Pikachu!
Port nativo de Pokémon: Let's Go, Eevee! e Pikachu!

description.p: A native port of the Nintendo Switch games Pokémon: Let's Go, Eevee! and Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu!, made by static recompilation: the games' ARM64 code is translated into C and compiled for the computer, and a runtime stands in for the Switch (system services, NVN graphics on Vulkan, audio, controllers). It is not an emulator.

The game code is recompiled on the player's own machine, once per game: the start screen asks for the folder with their own extracted copy of the game (the one with exefs and romfs), copies it, translates it and builds it for their computer.
No game files are included: you need your own legally obtained copy of the game, extracted. A fan project, not affiliated with Nintendo, The Pokémon Company, Game Freak or Creatures.
The Linux port: the runtime builds and runs on Debian 13 and Ubuntu 24.04, and there is a Debian package and an AppImage.
